Step: 43 weeks = 301 days.  
301 days + 3 days = 304 days added.  
1570 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
From 1570-04-15, add 304 days:  
April 15 → April 30 = 15 days (289 left)  
May 31 days → 258 left  
June 30 → 228 left  
July 31 → 197 left  
August 31 → 166 left  
September 30 → 136 left  
October 31 → 105 left  
November 30 → 75 left  
December 31 → 44 left  
1571-01-31 → 13 left  
1571-02-13 is the date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1571-02-13
